entries.title: Acts 22:3
segments:
Brought up in this city. He was sent to Jerusalem to be educated.
 

 
At the feet of Gamaliel. See note on

entries.title: Acts 22:5
segments: The high priest doth bear me witness, etc.  Paul here declares in effect that he can prove the truth of his statement, that he persecuted Christians, by the testimony of the high priest and the records of the Sanhedrin.  He could not have gone on his persecuting way without express authority.

entries.title: Acts 22:6
segments: A great light round about me. See notes on

entries.title: Acts 22:11
segments: When I could not see, etc.  See notes on

entries.title: Acts 22:22
segments: Unto this word. That is, up to the point at which he mentioned that he was to be sent far hence unto the Gentiles.

entries.title: Acts 22:24
segments: Examined by scourging. Subjected to torture until he confessed.  The chief captain resorted to this legal device in default of knowing what else to do.

entries.title: Acts 22:28
segments: I am a Roman born. Paul's family at Tarsus possessed Roman citizenship at the time of his birth.  See note
